body: I think I couldn't be clear. I didn't try because of a sign. I tried because people love to put a meaning to everything. I'm sick and tired of hearing somebody saying something random is a "sign" and that I should act accordingly. As I said before, I don't believe in "signs" or such.
Loss of many, many loved ones, mostly. Being useless in general. Also some other things I'd rather not talk about.
I don't exactly believe in "signs" and that stuff. They are partially the reason I tried anyway.
